articles.title_en: Review: Taxes on sugar-sweetened beverages: Political economy, and effects on prices, purchases, and consumption
articles.title_cn: 综述：含糖饮料税：政治经济学及其对价格、购买和消费的影响
articles.abstract_en: In response to a rise in obesity and diet-related chronic diseases such as diabetes, countries worldwide have sought ways to incentivize healthier diets. One of the most common recent policies is taxing sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs). This article introduces a virtual special collection of selected scholarship on SSB taxes that was published in Elsevier journals such as Food Policy, the Journal of Health Economics, and Economics & Human Biology. This article also summarizes the results of those studies regarding the political economy of SSB taxes, and how SSB taxes affect prices, sales, consumption, employment, and tax avoidance behaviors.
articles.abstract_cn: 为应对肥胖和与饮食相关的慢性疾病（如糖尿病）的上升，世界各国纷纷寻求激励更健康饮食的方法。近期最常见的政策之一是对含糖饮料（SSBs）征税。本文介绍了一个关于SSB税收的虚拟特辑，该特辑收录了发表在《食品政策》、《健康经济学杂志》和《经济学与人类生物学》等爱思唯尔期刊上的精选学术研究。本文还总结了这些研究关于SSB税收的政治经济学，以及SSB税收如何影响价格、销售、消费、就业和避税行为的结果。

articles.title_en: The economics of reducing food losses: Experimental evidence from improved storage technology in India
articles.title_cn: 减少粮食损失的经济学：来自印度改进储存技术的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Understanding the economics of food loss-reduction technologies is crucial to promote their adoption. We offer experimental evidence on returns to technology that studies a wide range of food security outcomes and accounts for the quality, quantity, and economic gains from adoption. Using two randomized experiments on improved storage with farmers in India, we find that food loss-reduction technology delivers large gains on multiple aspects of food security. The largest benefits of loss-reduction technology come from reduced quality and economic losses. Using a novel within-farmer experiment, we offer evidence of significant economic incentives for investing in loss-reduction technology in local rural markets. Our cost-benefit analysis shows that farmers recover the full unsubsidized cost of the reusable improved storage technology in one agricultural season.
articles.abstract_cn: 理解减少粮食损失技术的经济学对于促进其采用至关重要。我们提供了关于技术回报的实验证据，该研究涵盖了广泛的粮食安全结果，并考虑了采用带来的质量、数量和经济收益。通过在印度对农民进行两项关于改进储存的随机实验，我们发现减少粮食损失技术在粮食安全的多个方面带来了巨大收益。减少损失技术的最大好处来自于减少质量和经济损失。通过一项新颖的农民内部实验，我们提供了在当地农村市场投资于减少损失技术具有显著经济激励的证据。我们的成本效益分析表明，农民在一个农业季节内即可收回可重复使用的改进储存技术的全部未补贴成本。

articles.title_en: Greenhouse farming and employment: Evidence from Ecuador
articles.title_cn: 温室农业与就业：来自厄瓜多尔的证据
articles.abstract_en: The transforming agri-food sector is an important contributor to employment generation in rural areas of lower-income countries. However, little attention has been paid to the question of how technology affects the quality and quantity of employment in the sector. In this paper, we provide the first empirical evidence of how the rise in greenhouse farming changes labor demand (i.e., the number of employees), using large-scale and nationally representative agricultural survey data from Ecuador between 2014 and 2021 and pseudo-panel as well as event-study estimation techniques. Contrary to fears that more technologically advanced production methods displace large shares of the workforce, we find that greenhouse farming is associated with higher labor demand. Specifically, greenhouse farms hire more female workers and workers on permanent contracts.
articles.abstract_cn: 转型中的农食部门是低收入国家农村地区就业创造的重要贡献者。然而，关于技术如何影响该部门就业质量和数量的问题，却鲜少受到关注。在本文中，我们利用厄瓜多尔2014年至2021年间大规模且具有全国代表性的农业调查数据，以及伪面板和事件研究估计技术，首次提供了温室农业兴起如何改变劳动力需求（即雇员数量）的经验证据。与更先进的生产方法会取代大量劳动力的担忧相反，我们发现温室农业与更高的劳动力需求相关。具体而言，温室农场雇佣了更多的女性工人和签订永久合同的工人。

articles.title_en: From “good for people” to “good for people and planet” – Placing health and environment on equal footing when developing food-based dietary guidelines
articles.title_cn: 从“有益于人类”到“有益于人类与地球”——在制定基于食物的膳食指南时将健康与环境置于同等地位
articles.abstract_en: Dietary guidelines are a primary tool for promoting healthier and more sustainable diets. Despite several examples of dietary guidelines that consider - to various degrees - aspects of environmental sustainability, there is currently no framework that systematically incorporates environmental sustainability as a primary consideration. We present a five-step framework for developing environmentally sustainable dietary guidelines that would simultaneously meet nutritional requirements while staying within environmental boundaries. The steps comprise: 1) determining an average healthy diet for different population groups and criteria for healthy diets; 2) identifying relevant environmental aspects and establishing corresponding boundaries; 3) identifying systemic effects and crucial sustainability aspects; 4) altering the average diet to meet environmental goals and resolve trade-offs between environmental and nutritional goals; and 5) formulating sustainable food-based dietary guidelines. To exemplify the framework, we pilot it in the Swedish context, but it could be utilised for any other country.
articles.abstract_cn: 膳食指南是促进更健康和更可持续饮食的主要工具。尽管有一些膳食指南在不同程度上考虑了环境可持续性的方面，但目前尚无系统地将环境可持续性作为首要考虑因素的框架。我们提出了一个五步框架，用于制定环境可持续的膳食指南，该指南将同时满足营养需求并保持在环境边界内。这些步骤包括：1）确定不同人群的平均健康饮食和健康饮食标准；2）识别相关的环境方面并建立相应的边界；3）识别系统性效应和关键可持续性方面；4）调整平均饮食以达到环境目标并解决环境与营养目标之间的权衡；以及5）制定可持续的基于食物的膳食指南。为举例说明该框架，我们在瑞典背景下进行了试点，但它也可用于任何其他国家。

articles.title_en: Interplay between China’s grain self-sufficiency policy shifts and interregional, intertemporal productivity differences
articles.title_cn: 中国粮食自给政策转变与区域间、跨期生产率差异的相互作用
articles.abstract_en: In 2013, the Communist Party of China decided to partially relax its self-sufficiency targets for grain, historically first recognizing moderate imports as a policy option for ensuring food security in the country. This study empirically examines the interplay between the policy shifts and the interregional, intertemporal productivity differences in Chinese agriculture. It employs a meta-frontier stochastic output distance function approach. Our empirical result shows that input augmentation was the main contributor to the agricultural output growth during 1984–2000, whereas total factor productivity is the main driver of the growth during 2001–2020. This lends strong support to an argument in the literature that Chinese crop production has recently transformed from a resource-input-driven activity to one driven by science and technology. Our study also demonstrates that the western region, which far lagged behind others in the past in terms of agricultural technology, has made remarkable progress during 2001–2020, which confirms the cross-regional productivity convergence over time. It is likely that farmers in this region were better able to gain a higher economic return from crop diversification into horticulture, for which they might have been all the more motivated to improve their productivity.
articles.abstract_cn: 2013年，中国共产党决定部分放宽粮食自给目标，历史上首次将适度进口视为确保国家粮食安全的政策选项。本研究实证考察了政策转变与中国农业区域间、跨期生产率差异之间的相互作用。研究采用元前沿随机产出距离函数方法。实证结果表明，1984-2000年间，投入扩张是农业产出增长的主要贡献因素，而2001-2020年间，全要素生产率是增长的主要驱动力。这有力支持了文献中的一种观点，即中国作物生产近年来已从资源投入驱动型活动转变为科技驱动型活动。本研究还表明，过去在农业技术方面远远落后的西部地区在2001-2020年间取得了显著进步，这证实了跨区域生产率随时间的趋同。该地区农民可能更能从作物多样化转向园艺作物中获得更高的经济回报，这或许更加激励他们提高生产率。

articles.title_en: Where is the value? The impacts of sow gestation crate laws on pork supply and consumer value perceptions
articles.title_cn: 价值何在？母猪妊娠限位栏法律对猪肉供应和消费者价值感知的影响
articles.abstract_en: Despite varying farm animal welfare laws being enacted and considered, it is unclear and unknown whether they generate sufficient benefits to justify their costs. This study asks how sow gestation crate laws that dictate minimum crate size, a particular farm animal welfare law, impact meat production and the subsequent value that consumers place on meat produced under the laws. An observational analysis leverages the 8 states that have implemented laws regarding gestating sow crates in a difference-in-differences framework using staggered adoption robust estimators. We then perform a consumer preference experiment using a contingent valuation design with treatment effects to separate out the heterogeneous beliefs about animal welfare law effects. The results of the study show that such laws initially reduce gross income and supply, but only gross income recovers. For consumers, they value the corresponding pork products more in accordance with their animal welfare beliefs but not quality. Such information on costs and benefits should be considered in future laws relating to gestation crate bans.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管各种农场动物福利法律被制定和考虑，但尚不清楚它们是否产生足够的效益以证明其成本合理。本研究探讨了规定最小限位栏尺寸的母猪妊娠限位栏法律（一种特定的农场动物福利法律）如何影响肉类生产以及消费者对依据该法律生产的肉类所赋予的价值。一项观察性分析利用已实施关于妊娠母猪限位栏法律的8个州，在交错采用稳健估计器的双重差分框架下进行。随后，我们进行了一项消费者偏好实验，采用条件价值评估设计并设置处理效应，以分离关于动物福利法律效果的异质性信念。研究结果表明，此类法律最初会减少总收入和供应量，但只有总收入会恢复。对于消费者而言，他们根据其动物福利信念而非质量，对相应猪肉产品的价值评价更高。这些关于成本和效益的信息应在未来涉及限位栏禁令的法律中予以考虑。

articles.title_en: Processed foods, socio-economic status, and peri-urban obesity in India
articles.title_cn: 印度的加工食品、社会经济地位和城郊肥胖
articles.abstract_en: The ‘State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World 2020′ report states that switching to healthy diets will both prevent backsliding into hunger and help countries meet their sustainability goals. In 2019–2020, 17 percent of India’s adult population was undernourished. At the same time, however, 23 percent of all adults were obese. The increasing prevalence of obesity implies that improving diets and reducing risks for obesity and non-communicable diseases (NCDs) is a major food security challenge for India in the coming years. Overconsumption of calories from processed foods is known to increase the risk of obesity. To gain insights into the dietary transition and its relationship with obesity, we use cross-sectional data from a primary socio-economic survey conducted in the rural-urban interface of Bangalore, a mega-city in India that is characterized by high economic development. We show that for women in lower-middle socio-economic status (SES) groups, higher share of calories from semi-processed foods (SPF) is associated with a higher prevalence of obesity, while excess consumption of calories from ultra-processed foods (UPF) is associated with a higher obesity prevalence among women in higher SES groups. Older women and women who consume above the recommended daily allowance (RDA) of calories are more vulnerable to excess calories from SPF consumption than younger women and women who consume less than the RDA of calories. Furthermore, a lower prevalence of obesity is observed among women who consume excess calories from SPF but engage in labor-intensive occupational activity. These results speak to the need for interventions that incentivize weight loss and increased physical activity. The result that SPF consumption is associated with an increased prevalence of obesity especially among lower-middle SES group calls for interventions that increase access to and affordability of healthy diets. Policy instruments such as diversifying the public distribution system (PDS) are important to improve accessibility and affordability of healthy diets. In addition, increasing sugar and processed food taxes and incentivizing companies to invest in culturally sensitive food labeling should be considered to shift consumer demand towards healthier diet choices.
articles.abstract_cn: 《世界粮食安全和营养状况2020》报告指出，转向健康饮食既可以防止重新陷入饥饿，又可以帮助各国实现可持续发展目标。在2019-2020，17%的印度成年人口营养不良。然而，与此同时，23% 的所有成年人都肥胖。肥胖症患病率的日益增加意味着改善饮食并降低肥胖和非传染性疾病（NCD）风险是印度未来几年粮食安全的主要挑战。众所周知，过量摄入加工食品中的热量会增加肥胖的风险。为了深入了解饮食转变及其与肥胖的关系，我们使用了在班加罗尔城乡交界处进行的一项主要社会经济调查的横截面数据，班加罗尔是印度的一个以经济高度发展为特征的大城市。我们发现，对于中低社会经济地位（SES）群体的女性来说，来自半加工食品（SPF）的卡路里比例较高与较高的肥胖患病率相关，而来自超加工食品（UPF）的卡路里的过量消耗与较高社会经济地位群体的女性较高的肥胖患病率相关。与年轻女性和摄入热量低于建议每日摄入量 (RDA) 的女性相比，老年女性和摄入热量高于建议每日摄入量 (RDA) 的女性更容易因 SPF 摄入而摄入过量热量。此外，从 SPF 中摄入过量热量但从事劳动密集型职业活动的女性肥胖患病率较低。这些结果表明需要采取干预措施来激励减肥和增加体力活动。 SPF 消费与肥胖患病率增加相关，特别是在中低社会经济地位群体中，因此需要采取干预措施，增加健康饮食的获取和负担能力。公共分配系统（PDS）多样化等政策工具对于提高健康饮食的可及性和可负担性非常重要。此外，应考虑增加糖和加工食品的税收，并激励企业投资文化敏感的食品标签，以将消费者的需求转向更健康的饮食选择。

articles.title_en: Measure of indigenous perennial staple crop, Ensete ventricosum, associated with positive food security outcomes in southern Ethiopian highlands
articles.title_cn: 本土多年生主粮作物恩塞特（Ensete ventricosum）的种植面积与埃塞俄比亚南部高地积极粮食安全结果相关
articles.abstract_en: Enset-based food systems are unique to southern Ethiopia where they serve as a staple food for millions of households. Enset, a banana relative of which the entire pseudostem and corm are edible, possesses a highly unusual combination of crop traits including perenniality, highly flexible planting and harvest times, and tolerance of a very wide range of environmental conditions, which together earn it the local name of “the tree against hunger.” Previous studies have identified the strategic food security value of mature enset stands for household food security, but a multisector panel data set makes identifying wider enset food security associations tractable for the first time. We assess whether household data on area of mature enset is associated with four indicators of food security together with demographic, asset, and consumption covariates. We find that area of mature enset significantly improves estimates for three of four food security indicators, thus improving our understanding of the role of understudied indigenous crops. Consistent and reliable food security indicators are needed to improve monitoring, particularly with regard to stability. Variance components of multilevel longitudinal models indicate that exposure to both idiosyncratic and covariate disturbance affects food security stability in a way that is consistent with reports of enset acting as both a food security buffer and an active adaptation strategy in the face of shocks or change. Here we show that living assets comprising culturally relevant indigenous crops such as enset can improve accuracy of food insecurity assessments, which may encourage wider investigation of other agrifood system-specific asset-like natural stores of value associated with food security and resilience.
articles.abstract_cn: 以恩塞特为基础的粮食系统是埃塞俄比亚南部特有的，那里有数百万家庭将其作为主食。恩塞特是香蕉的近缘植物，其整个假茎和球茎均可食用，具有高度不寻常的作物性状组合，包括多年生性、高度灵活的种植和收获时间，以及对非常广泛环境条件的耐受性，这些共同为其赢得了当地名称“抗饥饿之树”。先前的研究已经确定了成熟恩塞特林地对家庭粮食安全的战略价值，但多部门面板数据集首次使得识别更广泛的恩塞特粮食安全关联变得可行。我们评估了家庭成熟恩塞特面积数据是否与四个粮食安全指标以及人口、资产和消费协变量相关。我们发现，成熟恩塞特面积显著改善了四个粮食安全指标中三个的估计，从而增进了我们对研究不足的本土作物作用的理解。需要一致且可靠的粮食安全指标来改进监测，特别是在稳定性方面。多水平纵向模型的方差成分表明，暴露于特质性和协变量扰动会影响粮食安全稳定性，这与恩塞特在面临冲击或变化时既作为粮食安全缓冲又作为积极适应策略的报告一致。在这里，我们表明，包含文化相关的本土作物（如恩塞特）在内的活资产可以提高粮食不安全评估的准确性，这可能鼓励更广泛地研究与粮食安全和韧性相关的其他农业食品系统特定的类似资产的自然价值储存。

articles.title_en: Sustainability, perceived quality and country of origin of farmed salmon: Impact on consumer choices in the USA, France and Japan
articles.title_cn: 养殖鲑鱼的可持续性、感知质量与原产地：对美国、法国和日本消费者选择的影响
articles.abstract_en: Technological advancements that enable countries to produce farmed seafood domestically, including land-based production, could potentially improve sustainability measures. However, whether consumers prefer domestic farmed seafood to imported seafood is unclear. This paper aims to fill this gap by employing hypothetical choice experiments from the US, France, and Japan. We find that, in each country, there is a sizable consumer segment (varying from one-quarter to two-thirds of the market) with a strong preference for domestic farmed salmon, including those from land-based production. These consumers associate domestic origin with higher qualities in all relevant dimensions and are willing to pay a price premium. There is also a segment of consumers with a strong preference for imported Norwegian salmon (from one-fifth to two-thirds of the market), linking Norwegian origin to higher qualities, and willing to pay higher prices. Consumers’ attitudes towards the environment and food, usage of label information, age, income, and consumption frequencies, are among the characteristics that explain consumer heterogeneity. Our results show the market potential for domestic farmed seafood, thus, providing consumers with reliable origin information for farmed seafood that also covers land-based production would be important. At the same time, the existence of a segment with a preference for imported seafood implies that active trade will remain, indicating the importance of continued international corporation for a holistic and transparent policy framework and common standards for a sustainable aquatic food system.
articles.abstract_cn: 技术进步使各国能够在国内生产养殖海鲜，包括陆基生产，这可能改善可持续性措施。然而，消费者是否偏好国内养殖海鲜而非进口海鲜尚不清楚。本文通过在美国、法国和日本进行的假设性选择实验来填补这一空白。我们发现，在每个国家，都有相当规模的消费者群体（占市场的四分之一到三分之二不等）对国内养殖鲑鱼有强烈偏好，包括来自陆基生产的鲑鱼。这些消费者将国内原产地与所有相关维度的更高质量联系起来，并愿意支付溢价。还有一部分消费者对进口挪威鲑鱼有强烈偏好（占市场的五分之一到三分之二），将挪威原产地与更高质量联系起来，并愿意支付更高的价格。消费者对环境和食品的态度、标签信息的使用、年龄、收入和消费频率等特征解释了消费者的异质性。我们的结果显示了国内养殖海鲜的市场潜力，因此，为消费者提供可靠的养殖海鲜原产地信息（包括陆基生产）将非常重要。同时，存在偏好进口海鲜的消费者群体意味着活跃的贸易将继续存在，这表明持续的国际合作对于建立全面透明的政策框架和共同标准以促进可持续的水产食品系统至关重要。

articles.title_en: Mechanism of Chinese farmers’ land rental participation: The role of invisible markets and public intervention
articles.title_cn: 中国农户土地流转参与机制：隐形市场与公共干预的作用
articles.abstract_en: This study focuses on the impact of invisible markets such as price, supply, demand, and public intervention through building intermediary organizations on rural households’ decisions to rent in or rent out land, and it compares factors that are critical in the current development of the land rental market. The study uses nationally representative farm and village survey datasets and the Box-Cox double-hurdle model. The study finds that public intervention, represented by intermediary organizations established at the grassroots level, plays a more significant role than invisible markets in improving the probability that farm households rent in or rent out land and increasing the amount of land rented. The intermediary organizations have increased the share of land area transferred to the total area at the village level. However, the price mechanisms, represented by the village-level land transfer rate and the village’s average land rent, failed to guide the flow of land resources. We put forward policy implications for how public institutions and market intermediaries can promote China’s land rental markets and how to perform price mechanisms more effectively.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究聚焦于价格、供给、需求等隐形市场以及通过建立中介组织进行的公共干预对农户租入或租出土地决策的影响，并比较了当前土地租赁市场发展中的关键因素。研究使用了具有全国代表性的农户和村庄调查数据集以及Box-Cox双障碍模型。研究发现，以基层建立的中介组织为代表的公共干预在提高农户租入或租出土地的概率和增加土地租赁量方面比隐形市场发挥更显著的作用。中介组织提高了村庄层面土地流转面积占总面积的比例。然而，以村庄土地流转率和村庄平均土地租金为代表的价格机制未能引导土地资源的流动。我们提出了关于公共机构和市场中介如何促进中国土地租赁市场以及如何更有效地发挥价格机制作用的政策启示。

articles.title_en: Measuring the impact of food rescue: A social return on investment analysis
articles.title_cn: 衡量食物救援的影响：社会投资回报分析
articles.abstract_en: Food rescue organisations in Aotearoa New Zealand help to reduce food waste and provide temporary relief to food insecurity. However, many of these organisations depend on donations and short-term philanthropic or government funding, which creates financial uncertainty and often requires them to demonstrate the impacts of their work with limited resourcing. While frameworks exist to demonstrate social value and associated monetary proxies like social return on investment (SROI), they are often resource-intensive and challenging to apply to multiple actors with different operating models like food rescue groups. This paper presents a SROI approach to measure the social value of three different food rescue models (Community Hub, Free Store, and Mixed model) in Aotearoa New Zealand. We describe how we adapted the seven guiding principles of SROI to explore how food rescue creates value for different actors in the food rescue process, including food donors, food recipient organisations, food rescue volunteers, and food rescue recipients. We used stakeholder interviews and quantitative data to develop nine primary outcomes. Financial proxy values were assigned to these outcomes, calculating an SROI ratio of NZD 4.5:1, indicating that an investment of $1 in food rescue delivers $4.5 of social value. This study adds to the growing literature on the impact of food rescue organisations and highlights the importance of taking a multi-case study approach to capture the true value created by this sector. Additionally, it emphasises the crucial role of food rescue organisations as ‘community connectors’ and their transformative potential in addressing food security issues.
articles.abstract_cn: 新西兰的食物救援组织有助于减少食物浪费，并为食物不安全提供临时救济。然而，这些组织中的许多依赖捐赠和短期慈善或政府资金，这造成了财务不确定性，并常常要求他们在资源有限的情况下展示其工作的影响。虽然存在展示社会价值及相关货币代理（如社会投资回报）的框架，但它们通常资源密集，难以应用于像食物救援团体这样具有不同运营模式的多个参与者。本文提出了一种社会投资回报方法，用于衡量新西兰三种不同食物救援模式（社区中心、免费商店和混合模式）的社会价值。我们描述了如何调整社会投资回报的七项指导原则，以探索食物救援如何为食物救援过程中的不同参与者（包括食物捐赠者、食物接收组织、食物救援志愿者和食物救援接收者）创造价值。我们使用利益相关者访谈和定量数据来开发九个主要结果。为这些结果分配了财务代理值，计算出新西兰元4.5:1的社会投资回报比率，表明在食物救援中投资1美元可带来4.5美元的社会价值。这项研究增加了关于食物救援组织影响的日益增长的文献，并强调了采取多案例研究方法以捕捉该部门创造的真实价值的重要性。此外，它强调了食物救援组织作为“社区连接者”的关键作用及其在解决食物安全问题中的变革潜力。

articles.title_en: Growing exports through ISO 9001 quality certification: Firm-level evidence from Chinese agri-food sectors
articles.title_cn: 通过ISO 9001质量认证促进出口增长：来自中国农业食品企业的证据
articles.abstract_en: The adoption of ISO 9001 quality certification for agri-food products may promote China’s relatively weak competitiveness in agri-food exports compared with industrial sectors. To explore this, we construct a panel data set of Chinese listed firms in agri-food sectors from 2000 to 2016 and use staggered Difference-in-Difference (DID) method to investigate the causal relationship between the adoption of ISO 9001 quality certification and agri-food exports. Three main findings are obtained in this study. First, we find that the adoption of ISO 9001 certification is positively associated with exports for agri-food listed firms. Second, we find that ISO 9001 certification promotes firms’ exports by increasing their innovation activities. Third, the export effects are greater for food (vs. non-food) manufacturing firms and non-SOEs (vs. SOEs). Identification problems are addressed by utilizing randomly generated certification status, two-part fractional regression model, controlling and excluding other quality certifications, etc. This study provides important implications for China’s food and agricultural development strategy, which emphasises the transition from quantity expansion to quality enhancement.
articles.abstract_cn: 农业食品产品采用ISO 9001质量认证可能促进中国在农业食品出口方面相对于工业部门较弱的竞争力。为探讨这一问题，我们构建了2000年至2016年中国农业食品行业上市公司的面板数据集，并采用交错双重差分（DID）方法研究ISO 9001质量认证采用与农业食品出口之间的因果关系。本研究获得三个主要发现。首先，我们发现采用ISO 9001认证与农业食品上市公司的出口正相关。其次，我们发现ISO 9001认证通过增加企业的创新活动促进企业出口。第三，出口效应在食品（相对于非食品）制造企业和非国有企业（相对于国有企业）中更大。通过利用随机生成的认证状态、两部分分数回归模型、控制并排除其他质量认证等方法解决了识别问题。本研究为中国强调从数量扩张向质量提升转变的食品和农业发展战略提供了重要启示。

articles.title_en: Food security among low-income immigrant households and the role of social capital: A case study of Somali-American households in the Midwestern United States
articles.title_cn: 低收入移民家庭中的食品安全与社会资本的作用：美国中西部索马里裔美国家庭案例研究
articles.abstract_en: Through analysis of primary data from 249 Somali American households in seven cities in the Midwestern United States, we present a case study, which reviews non-monetary constraints to food security, assesses food security and social capital in a low-income immigrant community, and estimates the relationship between food security and social capital. We measure social capital objectively as the size of the Somali American community in the urban center, while subjective (self-reported) measures of social capital include the respondents’ perception of support received from their community, interactions with members of their community, and membership in organized groups. Results confirm low levels of food security in Somali American population, a community that cannot be readily studied using secondary data such as the Current Population Survey due to the limited sample size. However, we find a positive association between objectively measured social capital and food security indicating higher levels of food security among respondents in larger Somali American communities within the study area. Association of food security with two self-reported measures (perceived community support and informal interactions) was inconclusive. The relationship between food security and the third self-reported measure (participation in organized groups) was not statistically significant.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过对美国中西部七个城市中249户索马里裔美国家庭的原始数据进行分析，我们呈现了一个案例研究，该研究审视了非货币性食品安全制约因素，评估了低收入移民社区中的食品安全与社会资本，并估计了食品安全与社会资本之间的关系。我们客观地将社会资本衡量为城市中心索马里裔美国人社区的规模，而主观（自我报告）的社会资本衡量指标包括受访者对其社区所获支持的感知、与社区成员的互动以及有组织团体的成员身份。结果证实索马里裔美国人群体中的食品安全水平较低，该群体由于样本量有限，难以使用诸如当前人口调查之类的二手数据进行研究。然而，我们发现客观衡量的社会资本与食品安全之间存在正相关关系，表明在研究区域内较大的索马里裔美国人社区中，受访者的食品安全水平较高。食品安全与两项自我报告指标（感知的社区支持和非正式互动）之间的关联不明确。食品安全与第三项自我报告指标（参与有组织团体）之间的关系在统计上不显著。

articles.title_en: Retail food environment and household food waste: An empirical study
articles.title_cn: 零售食品环境与家庭食物浪费：一项实证研究
articles.abstract_en: We examine the relationship between the retail food environment for individual households and household food waste. Conceptually the relationship is ambiguous and depends on how store access interacts with frequency, size, and the composition of food purchases. We use FoodAPS data to estimate the relationship between store proximity and household food waste. We measure this relationship for different retail food store formats and also investigate heterogeneity and mediating factors. We find that a 1% increase in the distance to the nearest small food store is associated with 0.02% more food waste among all households. A 1% increase in the distance to the nearest large food store – such as supermarkets and grocery stores – is associated with 0.05% more food waste among households in poverty, with larger associations among households without cars. We find that shopping frequency and size do not mediate the relationship between large food store proximity and food waste, but we find differences over the amount of fresh foods purchased on the average shopping trip. Among households that purchase large amounts of fresh foods per trip, greater distance to a large food store is substantially associated with more food waste. Our results contribute to policy discussions surrounding food waste as well as food access.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了单个家庭的零售食品环境与家庭食物浪费之间的关系。从概念上讲，这种关系是模糊的，取决于商店可达性如何与购物频率、规模以及食品购买构成相互作用。我们使用FoodAPS数据来估计商店邻近性与家庭食物浪费之间的关系。我们针对不同的零售食品商店业态衡量这种关系，并调查异质性和中介因素。我们发现，到最近的小型食品商店的距离每增加1%，所有家庭的食物浪费增加0.02%。到最近的大型食品商店（如超市和杂货店）的距离每增加1%，贫困家庭的食物浪费增加0.05%，其中无车家庭的关联更大。我们发现购物频率和规模并不中介大型食品商店邻近性与食物浪费之间的关系，但我们在平均购物行程中购买的新鲜食品数量上发现了差异。在每次购物行程中购买大量新鲜食品的家庭中，到大型食品商店的距离更远与更多的食物浪费显著相关。我们的结果有助于围绕食物浪费和食品获取的政策讨论。

articles.title_en: Maximizing nutrition in key food value chains of Mongolia under climate change
articles.title_cn: 气候变化下最大化蒙古关键食物价值链的营养
articles.abstract_en: Mongolia’s projected warming is far above the global average and could exceed 5 °C by the end of the century. The reliance on pastoral livestock and rainfed agriculture along with its fragile ecosystems put Mongolia’s economy at risk of adverse climate change impacts, particularly from climate extreme events. Eighty percent of Mongolia’s agricultural sector is concentrated in animal husbandry with around one third of the population relying on this livelihood. Beyond livestock, food production is concentrated in few crops: wheat; potatoes; and three vegetables (cabbage, carrot, and turnip). Climate change does not only affect food production but can exacerbate malnutrition by removing food and nutrients in all stages of the food value chain. To identify perceived effects of climate change and measures to reduce climate change impacts in Mongolia's’s key food value chains, we implemented focus group discussions with 214 livestock and vegetable producers, traders, and food consumers. We also conducted 30 key informant interviews at the soum, provincial, and national levels across four agroecosystems in three provinces. Based on this community engagement analysis, we identify interventions that the government and private sector, including herders and farmers, should undertake to increase the food security and nutrition of the country’s prioritized food value chains under climate change.
articles.abstract_cn: 蒙古预计的变暖幅度远高于全球平均水平，到本世纪末可能超过5°C。对畜牧养殖和雨养农业的依赖，加上其脆弱的生态系统，使蒙古经济面临气候变化不利影响的风险，尤其是极端气候事件。蒙古农业部门的百分之八十集中在畜牧业，约三分之一的人口依赖这一生计。除牲畜外，粮食生产集中在少数作物：小麦、马铃薯和三种蔬菜（卷心菜、胡萝卜和芜菁）。气候变化不仅影响粮食生产，还可能通过去除食物价值链各阶段的食物和营养来加剧营养不良。为了识别气候变化对蒙古关键食物价值链的感知影响以及减少气候变化影响的措施，我们与214名牲畜和蔬菜生产者、贸易商及食品消费者进行了焦点小组讨论。我们还在三个省四个农业生态系统的苏木、省和国家层面进行了30次关键知情人访谈。基于这一社区参与分析，我们确定了政府和私营部门（包括牧民和农民）应采取的措施，以在气候变化下提高该国优先食物价值链的粮食安全和营养。

articles.title_en: Viewpoint: Ensuring affordability of diets in the face of shocks
articles.title_cn: 观点：在冲击面前确保膳食的可负担性
articles.abstract_en: Climate-related shocks, the COVID-19 pandemic, and the war in Ukraine have exacerbated world hunger, making it more difficult for people to meet their nutritional needs. This viewpoint examines, for 136 countries, the ability of populations to afford an energy-sufficient and a healthy diet in the face of shocks. Using pre-pandemic data from 2019, we calculate the percentage of countries’ populations at risk of losing access to these diets in the event of a one-tenth, one-fifth, or one-third reduction in real income. We find that, in addition to the 152 million people who were unable to afford a basic energy-sufficient diet in 2019, up to 260 million people (mostly in low-income and lower-middle income countries) are vulnerable to not being able to afford it should a shock reduce real income by up to one-third. The more expensive healthy diet, which was already out of reach for 3 billion people before the pandemic, risks becoming inaccessible to an additional 968 million people (nearly all in middle-income countries). Our findings indicate that addressing income inequality is key when trying to ensure access to energy-sufficient diets, while raising mean income and reducing diet cost are increasingly relevant for ensuring access to healthy diets, especially following a shock. We thus provide insights on how countries facing shocks will need a varying mix of social protection, income stabilization, lowering the cost of nutritious foods, and investing in broader economic development.
articles.abstract_cn: 与气候相关的冲击、COVID-19大流行以及乌克兰战争加剧了世界饥饿，使人们更难满足其营养需求。本文考察了136个国家的人口在面临冲击时负担得起能量充足和健康膳食的能力。利用2019年疫情前数据，我们计算了在真实收入减少十分之一、五分之一或三分之一的情况下，各国人口面临失去这些膳食获取风险的比例。我们发现，除了2019年无法负担基本能量充足膳食的152百万人口外，若冲击使真实收入减少至三分之一，多达260百万人口（主要来自低收入和中等偏低收入国家）将面临无法负担该膳食的风险。更为昂贵的健康膳食，在疫情前已有3十亿人无法触及，现在可能再有968百万人口（几乎全部来自中等收入国家）面临无法获取的风险。我们的研究结果表明，在努力确保能量充足膳食获取时，解决收入不平等是关键；而提高平均收入和降低膳食成本对于确保健康膳食获取日益重要，尤其是在冲击之后。因此，我们提供了关于面临冲击的国家如何需要不同组合的社会保护、收入稳定、降低营养食品成本以及投资于更广泛经济发展的见解。

articles.title_en: Measuring changes in diet deprivation: New indicators and methods
articles.title_cn: 衡量饮食匮乏的变化：新指标与新方法
articles.abstract_en: Improving diet quality is an emerging development policy priority. Existing indicators emphasize the cost and affordability of healthy diets but have not attempted to measure how far households are from ideal diets or how policies may nudge them closer to them. We propose a new Reference Diet Deprivation (ReDD) index, estimated from household consumption survey data, that measures the incidence, breadth, and depth of diet deprivation across multiple food groups. While informative as a standalone measure, we demonstrate how the ReDD index can be integrated into an economic model to examine changes in diet quality under different policy or external shocks. Our Nigerian case study shows that productivity growth in the dairy, pulse & nut, fruit, and red meat value chains have more potential than staple crops to reduce diet deprivation. While these findings have implications for food and agricultural policy prioritization in Nigeria, the study more importantly demonstrates the usefulness of the ReDD index for assessing diet quality and examining the drivers of dietary change when used in conjunction with a simulation model.
articles.abstract_cn: 改善饮食质量是一个新兴的发展政策优先事项。现有指标强调健康饮食的成本和可负担性，但并未尝试衡量家庭距离理想饮食有多远，或政策如何能促使他们更接近理想饮食。我们提出了一个新的参考饮食匮乏（ReDD）指数，该指数基于家庭消费调查数据估算，衡量跨多个食物组的饮食匮乏的发生率、广度和深度。虽然作为独立指标具有信息量，但我们展示了如何将ReDD指数整合到经济模型中，以考察在不同政策或外部冲击下饮食质量的变化。我们的尼日利亚案例研究表明，乳制品、豆类与坚果、水果和红肉价值链的生产率增长比主粮作物更有潜力减少饮食匮乏。虽然这些发现对尼日利亚的粮食和农业政策优先排序具有启示意义，但该研究更重要的是证明了ReDD指数在评估饮食质量和考察饮食变化驱动因素方面的实用性，当与模拟模型结合使用时。

articles.title_en: How information, social norms, and experience with novel meat substitutes can create positive political feedback and demand-side policy change
articles.title_cn: 信息、社会规范和新奇肉类替代品的体验如何产生积极的政治反馈和需求侧政策变革
articles.abstract_en: The food system causes more than a third of the global anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions, of which half are from livestock. Shifting towards plant-based diets could significantly reduce deforestation, protect biodiversity, and contribute to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and Paris climate targets. Arguably, large-scale shifts in meat consumption require ambitious policy change. Yet, deep-rooted eating habits, pleasure, cultural status, and personal freedom are just a few of many obstacles to adopt ambitious demand-side policies and reduce meat consumption. Here, we hypothesize that technological innovation in meat substitutes, if effectively combined with social norm and factual informational triggers for behavioral changes, can foster positive political feedback to transform the food system. To test our hypothesis, we conducted survey experiments with citizens (N = 2590) in China and the US – the globally largest meat markets – and analyzed data using different machine learning methods. Our findings show that personal experience with novel plant-based meat substitutes strongly predicts individuals’ intentions to reduce their meat consumption, eat more substitutes, and support public policies to catalyze a transition to more plant-based diets. We also find that in both countries factual and social norm information about the benefits of more plant-based diets can increase citizens’ behavioral change intentions and support for meat reduction policies. Overall, however, social norm information had no significant additional effects on the outcomes compared to the simple factual information treatments. In the US, prior experience with innovative meat substitutes potentially can boost the positive effects of informational campaigns on public support for meat reduction policies. The results offer promising implications for a policy sequencing strategy to create positive political feedback and enable socio-technical tipping dynamics for sustainable food system transformation.
articles.abstract_cn: 食品系统造成了超过三分之一的全球人为温室气体排放，其中一半来自畜牧业。转向植物性饮食可以显著减少森林砍伐，保护生物多样性，并有助于实现可持续发展目标和巴黎气候目标。可以说，肉类消费的大规模转变需要雄心勃勃的政策变革。然而，根深蒂固的饮食习惯、愉悦感、文化地位和个人自由只是采取雄心勃勃的需求侧政策和减少肉类消费的众多障碍中的几个。在此，我们假设肉类替代品的技术创新，如果有效地与社会规范和事实信息触发行为改变相结合，可以促进积极的政治反馈，以转变食品系统。为了验证我们的假设，我们在中国和美国——全球最大的肉类市场——对公民（N = 2590）进行了调查实验，并使用不同的机器学习方法分析数据。我们的研究结果表明，个人对新奇植物性肉类替代品的体验强烈预测了个体减少肉类消费、食用更多替代品以及支持公共政策以促进向更多植物性饮食转变的意图。我们还发现，在这两个国家，关于更多植物性饮食益处的事实和社会规范信息可以增加公民的行为改变意图和对肉类减少政策的支持。然而，总体而言，与简单的事实信息处理相比，社会规范信息对结果没有显著的额外影响。在美国，先前对创新肉类替代品的体验可能有助于增强信息宣传活动对肉类减少政策公众支持的积极影响。这些结果为政策排序策略提供了有希望的含义，以创造积极的政治反馈并实现可持续食品系统转型的社会技术临界动态。
